_how_to_edit: Immediate actions shown on the dashboard for each critical alert. Edit freely; the running backend picks up changes on the next frame (no restart).
Keys are alert kinds: 'lockup', 'wheelspin', 'overheat' and 'pressure' raise critical alerts; 'default' is used for any other kind.
Each entry has a 'title' and a list of 'actions', shown in order. Keep each action short and in the imperative.
Placeholders: {tire} (e.g. RR), {tire_name} (e.g. rear-right), {axle} (front or rear), {side} (left or right).
If this file has a mistake (invalid JSON or a missing field), the backend logs a warning and uses its built-in actions.

lockup.title: {tire} locked up: flat-spot risk
actions: Radio the driver: brake earlier and lighter into this corner; the {tire_name} locked for over a second.
Ask the driver about vibration under braking: a sign of a flat spot.
If there is vibration, box this lap for a new set.

wheelspin.title: {tire} heavy wheelspin
actions: Radio the driver: feed the throttle in gently out of slow corners.
Short-shift on corner exit to take torque off the {axle} tires.
Watch the {tire_name} temperature next lap; box if it overheats.

overheat.title: {tire} over the temperature limit
actions: Radio the driver: lift and coast into the next braking zones to cool the {tire_name} tire.
Ease the load on the {side} side: smoother steering through fast corners.
If it is still above the limit after one more lap, box this lap for a new set.

pressure.title: {tire} losing air
actions: Box this lap: the {tire_name} tire has lost air.
Radio the driver: stay off the kerbs and reduce speed through high-load corners.
Crew: prepare a new set and check the {tire_name} rim and valve for damage.

default.title: {tire} critical
actions: Radio the driver and check the {tire_name} tire.
